description: This Java source file defines a Spring Security configuration class, setting up security filters for a web application. It configures HTTP security rules, disables CSRF, permits all requests, and ignores static and documentation-related paths from security filters.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up security filter chains and web security ignoring rules for the application.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Configures the main HTTP security filter chain, disabling CSRF, setting frame options, permitting all requests, and disabling default login mechanisms.

methods.name: webSecurityCustomizer
methods.description: Specifies URL patterns for static assets, API docs, Swagger UI, and H2 console to ignore security filtering for improved performance and usability.
